story.body: You set five, six and ten on the page as the shape of his ask. You left the words of the death unwritten. You did not choose.

participation.context: Refused the page a longer death.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: the refusal stands after the line has gone quiet
relations.quote: I will not give him six to make the mercy longer.

story.body: You repeated the vault's answer and stopped. The number stays five. The words stay unwritten until the yard.

title: Said she wakes hoarse, and left the five words
